1	# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
2	# SET UP THE DATABASE FOR TOOLS
3	# ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
4	
5	terraform {
6	  required_version = "~> 1.0"
7	
8	  required_providers {
9	    aws = {
10	      source                = "hashicorp/aws"
11	      version               = "~> 4.0"
12	      configuration_aliases = [aws.backup]
13	    }
14	    vault = {
15	      source  = "hashicorp/vault"
16	      version = "~> 3.0"
17	    }
18	    random = {
19	      version = "~> 3.6.0"
20	    }
21	  }
22	}
23	
24	locals {
25	  name         = var.name != "" ? var.name : "tools-database-${var.env}"
26	  kms_key_name = "${local.name}-db-key"
27	}
28	
29	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
30	# CREATE KMS KEYS
31	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
32	
33	module "database_kms" {
34	  source  = "crow.infrastructure.immuta.io/internal/security-kms-key/aws"
35	  version = "1.4.0"
36	  count   = var.storage_encrypted ? 1 : 0
37	
38	  customer_master_keys = {
39	    (local.kms_key_name) = {
40	      allow_manage_key_permissions_with_iam = true
41	      deletion_window_in_days               = var.kms_key_deletion_window_in_days

45	    }
46	  }
47	}
48

53	  depends_on = [module.database_kms]
54	
55	  description             = "KMS Replica Key for tools database"
56	  deletion_window_in_days = var.kms_key_deletion_window_in_days
57	  primary_key_arn         = module.database_kms[0].key_arns[local.kms_key_name]
58	
59	  tags = var.tags
60	}
61	
62	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

64	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
65

67	  source  = "crow.infrastructure.immuta.io/internal/data-database-rds/aws"

69	
70	  providers = {
71	    aws.backup = aws.backup
72	  }
73	
74	  name               = local.name
75	  pg_version         = var.pg_version
76	  env                = var.env
77	  ca_cert_identifier = var.ca_cert_identifier
78	
79	  db_name        = var.db_name
80	  admin_username = var.admin_username
81	  instance_class = var.rds_instance_size
82	
83	  enhanced_monitoring_enabled  = var.enhanced_monitoring_enabled
84	  performance_insights_enabled = var.performance_insights_enabled
85	  multi_az                     = var.multi_az
86	
87	  kms_key_arn             = var.storage_encrypted ? module.database_kms[0].key_arns[local.kms_key_name] : ""
88	  kms_replication_key_arn = var.storage_encrypted && var.encrypt_replicas ? aws_kms_replica_key.replica_key[0].arn : ""
89	
90	  vpc_id              = var.vpc_id
91	  subnet_ids          = var.private_subnet_ids
92	  trusted_cidr_blocks = var.trusted_cidr_blocks
93	
94	  subnet_group_name_override       = var.subnet_group_name_override
95	  dba_security_group_name_override = var.dba_security_group_name_override
96	  security_group_name_override     = var.security_group_name_override
97	
98	  allocated_storage     = var.allocated_storage
99	  max_allocated_storage = var.max_allocated_storage
100	  storage_encrypted     = var.storage_encrypted
101	  storage_type          = var.storage_type
102	
103	  backup_retention_period  = var.backup_retention_period
104	  replica_retention_period = var.replica_retention_period
105	  final_snapshot           = var.final_snapshot
106	  encrypt_replicas         = var.encrypt_replicas
107	
108	  tags = var.tags
109	
110	  depends_on = [module.database_kms, aws_kms_replica_key.replica_key]
111	}
112	
113	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
